notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes: A number of bugs related to claiming Steam Achievements, loading progress, and bonus levels have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]11 New Features:[/h1]
[h2]1. Skill Tree[/h2]
Unlock new skills while progressing into the story. Skills available: Wall Jump, Dash, Dive Dash, Double and Triple Jump, Time Shift and Magnet.
[h2]2. New Currency[/h2]
Make your gameplay more satisfying by collecting new points. Then, buy new items and unlock areas with it.
[h2]3. New Customization Options[/h2]
Discover range of hats purchasable in new Hat Shop in the town and make your character even more your own. More options are still to come!
[h2]4. Wider Diversity of Levels and Puzzles[/h2]
We've introduced few more interesting mechanics to the game, so that every next level is fresh and unique.
[h2]5. Bonus Levels Redesigned[/h2]
Not only are new rats levels more challenging but also more interesting to play. Now, they're a perfect choice if you want to test your skills!
[h2]6. Enchanced Interface[/h2]
"Agent Hub" available under X key is now redesigned. New animations as well as ways of use make it integrated part of the game that is of use to player.
[h2]7. Boss Fight Rework[/h2]
Even though Obo Boss looks the same, we changed the way it works. Boss area has also been tweaked, so the fight is more enjoyable and action-packed.
[h2]8. Steam Achievements[/h2]
Collecting Steam Achievements is now possible in Mr Meal.
[h2]9. Meal Bases Redesigned[/h2]
All the Mr Meal's bases has been redesigned to meet the requirements of new skills unlocked by a player.
[h2]10. Main Menu Rework[/h2]
New Main Menu is more user friendly and has some more options. There is a new, separated tab for credits as well.
[h2]11. Bar in the Town[/h2]
New, ineteresting place in town to discover!

On top of that, there has been a lot of tweeks and bug fixes. If you still encounter any bugs, please report them on our [url= https://discord.gg/S6yJkKt]Discord server[/url]. Have a nice day!

notes.title: Mr Meal 1.0 Released! (Update 5)
notes.notes:
Dear Agents, today is a special day: we are giving you the 1.0 version! This means that the game is no longer in Early Access. Check out all the new features and changes below, and enjoy the complete game with the final chapter!

[h1]The final chapter: „The Lost City”[/h1]

[list]
[*] Lot’s of new quests and plot elements
[*] 7 new stages
[*] New sections of the Agency
[*] Grand finale in the game
[*] Expanded secret club
[*] More secrets & plot reveals
[*] New endgame locations and activities in the Town
[/list]

[h1]Other changes and improvements:[/h1]

[list]
[*] New colour grading
[*] New completion percentage indicator
[*] Loads of new activities in the Town (new minigame and interactive objects)
[*] Locations in the Town reworked
[*] New checkpoint indicator
[*] Some Mr Meal’s bases (2nd chapter) reworked
[*] New interactive objects in the 1st and the 2nd chapter
[*] Graphical tweaks to Agency building
[*] Sound engine redesigned
[/list] And more!

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bug related to interaction indicator
[*] Issues with switching between levels
[*] Bugs with bombs thrown by the robot
[*] Bugs with cutting machine saving fixed
[*] Using power-ups near interactive objects in Town could cause glitches
[*] Bugs related to the black ambient rendering
[/list] And many more!

I would like to thank everyone who has supported me in this project - my family, friends, all the playtesters and early access buyers. This means a lot to me, more than 2.5 years of work which have resulted in the full version of the game. I am sorry for any bugs that may arise - I will fix them as soon as I get to know about them. Enjoy your time playing!

Feel free to join my [url=https://discord.gg/S6yJkKt]Discord Server[/url] or subscribe to my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsV4AYBusYg1FHnEvbKTRaw]youtube channel[/url] if you like to follow my future projects!

~ Pan Gangowski

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:

[*] The finale of the second chapter is now fully working and complete.
[*] Preparations for the first major content update - new buildings in the town that can be entered.

[*] New behaviour of town folks: when you break down the barrier between the first and the second districts, the town folks will start walking between them.
[*] New town folks in the second distrcit.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to the metro in the town.
[*] Fixed bugs when choosing answers.
[*] The cutscene with Mr Meal's train has been improved.
[*] Some texts and dialogues have been improved.

[/list]
First big content update coming soon! If you find a bug or have a suggestion, share it on the Steam forum or on our Discord server!
